title: `rsc_card` widget throws Error with no content; `rsc_table` and `rsc_grid` give a Warning.
description:
Currently, if `rsc_grid` or `rsc_table` are called on a content list with no records, a warning is thrown, but the document will render.  If `rsc_card` has no records, it throws an Error and the document or application will fail.  The more forgiving Warning is preferred so as no to break deployments if dynamically generated content changes.

Example output showing the errors (sorry, not a reprex)

```
> project_r %>%
+   filter(str_detect(title, "API")) %>%
+   rsc_table()
Warning message:
In rsc_table(.) : rsc_table() was called with an empty data frame.
> project_r %>%
+   filter(str_detect(title, "API")) %>%
+   rsc_grid()
Warning message:
In rsc_grid(.) : rsc_grid() was called with an empty data frame.
> project_r %>%
+   filter(str_detect(title, "API")) %>%
+   rsc_card()
Error in rsc_card(.) : 
  rsc_card() expects a data frame with at least one record.
```

title: Future support and development of the connectwidgets package?
description:
Is this project part of the Posit Connect roadmap going forward? I attempted to run the "Hello World" type example and right off the bat ran into issues that make the output unworkable for me. Each card element in the grid layout took up the entire screen width, and content images were not retrieved even after I deployed to connect. 

![image](https://github.com/rstudio/connectwidgets/assets/19575728/edab6f32-ef9d-4c67-93f2-c8c02c5edbf9)

All of these issues were already reported over a year ago: [#66: connectwidgets CSS clash](https://github.com/rstudio/connectwidgets/issues/66), [#71: preview image in connectwidgets](https://github.com/rstudio/connectwidgets/issues/71), and [#72: Grid view not working](https://github.com/rstudio/connectwidgets/issues/72). 

If working as designed, this project would fill a big gap for our organization - quickly generating a variety of different curated landing pages for different user roles or topic categories. title: content() funtion returns NAs for created_time and updated_time
description:
Dear Team,

I found that content() function returns NAs for `created_time` and `updated_time` with RStudio Connect v2022.09.0.
This is because the` format_iso8601` function is not needed anymore, since dates are already in ISO8601 format.

https://github.com/rstudio/connectwidgets/blob/3b5c1fbe9f72a511b485d9fc0b43c16464cd8b85/R/content.R#L56-L57

May I kindly ask you to check, please?

Best regards,
Yulia

title: Misleading error message from `compareVersion`
description:
Hi, 

We were running into an issue on our landing pages that was telling us that our RSC server wasn't up to date, despite us running the latest version (2021.12)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29882604/146256038-76ad766e-eb6d-4cfa-9471-7827f3cb296c.png)

After somedebugging, we realised the issue was that the version number was being hidden by the server as per here: https://docs.rstudio.com/connect/admin/appendix/configuration/#Server.HideVersion

Wondering, does the version number comparison need to be a hard check, i.e., error if the comparison fails ? Should it still run if the version is hidden? 

If it should fail, then can we update the error message if there is no version number coming through

https://github.com/rstudio/connectwidgets/blob/8282758bb32bf8520c5fd681028f791b56ef7850/R/connect.R#L84-L92

title: Grid does not update when used inside a Shiny app
description:
Reprex:

```
library(shiny)
library(connectwidgets)
library(dplyr)


connect_server <- Sys.getenv("CONNECT_SERVER")
connect_key <- Sys.getenv("CONNECT_API_KEY")
client <- connect(server  = connect_server, api_key = connect_key)
all_content <- content(client)   

app_modes <- all_content %>% 
  group_by(app_mode) %>% 
  summarise() %>% 
  pull()

ui <- fluidPage(
  radioButtons("type", label = "Type", choices = app_modes),
  rscgridOutput("grid")
)
  
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$grid <- renderRscgrid({
    all_content %>% 
      filter(app_mode == input$type) %>% 
      head(10) %>% 
      rsc_grid()
  })
}
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```

title: treatment of unpublished content
description:
It is possible to request "unpublished" content:

```r
all_content <- connectwidgets::content(widgetclient, unpublished = TRUE)
```

However, this content is not specially treated in the UI.

These items will likely be given a "Type" of "Other"; this is insufficient, as new (unknown) content types will also be categorized as "Other". Also ambiguous because of #46.

Unpublished items can only be visited in the dashboard by content collaborators and administrators; they have not had successful deployments.

title: categorization of static and rmd-static content
description:
The `content_type_icon` and `content_type_label` implementations have two minor oversights:

1. When `app_mode` is "static" or "rmd-static", a `content_category` of "site" indicates that the content is a multi-page deployment (e.g. bookdown content). 

1. When `app_mode` is "static" and has no `content_category`, regard that as a "Document" rather than "Other".

title: Bulk upload/change of content image
description:

For example, if I have 100 pieces of content, I could use RStudio Connect's API to change many pieces of content at once, and then `connectwidgets` will be able to respect those changes in the various views.

title: Inconsistencies between rscpages and connectapi
description:
Between rscpages and connectapi, the content() function behaves differently. This should be consistent for user experience. 

Also for consistency, column names and columns returned should be consistent between the two packages.

title: content() call returns unpublished items
